summary: Super Micro Computer, Inc. filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a mandatory convertible preferred stock offering of 75M depositary shares (each 1/20th interest, liquidation preference $50). Terms: dividend rate TBD, cumulative, payable quarterly in cash or common stock; mandatory conversion into common stock on June 1, 2029 based on VWAP; optional conversion at minimum rate. Concurrently, a separate $1.25B common stock offering and a $2B ATM program are planned. The offering is not conditioned on these transactions. Proceeds intended for general corporate purposes. Watch for pricing, dividend rate setting and potential dilution impact.
